name: Alcaldía de Armenia
body: Two-year HSTS with preload, a content security policy, security.txt, and a permanent https redirect. But no page analyzed wraps its content in <main>, so screen reader users can't jump past the menus.
lesson: Wrap each page's content in one <main>, which screen readers offer as a skip link.
summary: www.armenia.gov.co scores 83 out of 100 (B). 0 checks fail now, 22 are at risk, and 16 pass. Fix first: 45 images have no alt attribute.

fix.title: 45 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 20 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /transparencia-1712, /atencion-y-servicio-a-la-ciudadania/mecanismos-de-atencion-al-ciudadano, /atencion-y-servicio-a-la-ciudadania/tramites-y-servicios and 16 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: 19 structured data items miss a property Google expects
fix.evidence: /transparencia-1712 Article lacks author, datePublished, /atencion-y-servicio-a-la-ciudadania/mecanismos-de-atencion-al-ciudadano Article lacks author, datePublished, /atencion-y-servicio-a-la-ciudadania/tramites-y-servicios Article lacks author,…
fix.fix: Fill the missing properties so the item qualifies for rich results.

fix.title: 3 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /sitemap.xml: armenia.gov.co (3). The sitemap should list only URLs on https://www.armenia.gov.co.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: 20 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /, /transparencia-1712, /atencion-y-servicio-a-la-ciudadania/mecanismos-de-atencion-al-ciudadano, /atencion-y-servicio-a-la-ciudadania/tramites-y-servicios and 16 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.
